title: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44): Service Standards for Certificate Copies
content:
Copies of a filed Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) certificate are issued on the following standards. They are identical for the SR-22 Owner, Operator and Owner-Operator Certificates and for the FR-44 Owner, Operator and Owner-Operator Certificates.

| Standard | Value |
|---|---|
| Copy fee | 0.00 USD (no charge) |
| Delivery channels | email; mail; online portal |
| Mailed copy | sent within 2 business days |
| Filing status in which a copy may be issued | filed |
| Recipients | the named insured; the filed driver; a court or attorney designated by the insured |

**Reading the standards**

- *Is a copy delivered by phone?* No. Phone is not among the delivery channels.
- *May a copy go to an attorney the filed driver chose?* The recipient list names a court or attorney designated by the insured. A recipient outside that list is not a copy recipient.
- *Hypothetical:* a mailed copy requested on a Wednesday in a week with no holiday is sent within 2 business days, so by the Friday.
